desc:
Welcome to JJ Mod! ✅
A sandbox inspired by Garry’s Mod where you can build, experiment, and create chaos with physics, weapons, and ragdolls. (it’s way more fun with friends! 👋).

--
Endless creativity in a physics-driven world 🦩

--
Controls (PC):  🖥️

WASD – Move
Left Click – Fire weapon / Pick object (Physics Gun)
Right Click – Alt Fire / Freeze object (Physics Gun)
E + Mouse – Rotate object
E - Interact
Z – Undo last item
C – Context Menu
Q – Spawn Menu
V - NoClip
F – Toggle Flashlight

--
Controls (Controller): 🎮

RT – Fire weapon / Pick object
LT – Alt Fire / Freeze object
DPad Down – Undo
DPad Left – Context Menu
DPad Up – Spawn Menu
DPad Right - NoClip
Y – Flashlight

--
Credits:

PolyHall – Owner, Programming, UI, SFX, Music 👨‍💻
Jarold741 – Co-Owner, Building, Modeling, Lighting 👷
